hook: Building a wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo
hookText: Building a wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo

beats.say: A hobbyist built a wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo, bringing the 1990s console online with homebrew hardware.
In practice this makes the save sync delay imperceptible, and only when an existing save is pulled by the SNES for the first time is there a 1-2s load screen.
The challenge was the time to first token of the LLM, for Haiku it was about 0.8 s but for Opus it averaged 2.2 s.
